newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ABERDEEN BEAT HIBS TO CLOSE GAP ON OLD FIRM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ABERDEEN BEAT HIBS TO CLOSE GAP ON OLD FIRM.

text.p: Third-placed Aberdeen beat Hibernian 1-0 on Saturday to move within four points of Celtic and seven points of Rangers at the top of the Scottish premier division.
Dean Windass scored the only goal of an entertaining match a minute before half-time and the visitors then withstood a barrage of Hibs assaults.
"I thought we showed great grit and determination," Aberdeen manager Roy Aitken said. "We created a lot of chances and it's always nice to keep a clean sheet, so overall it was a very good day."
In the only other premier division match to survive the Scottish winter weather, Dundee United lost 2-1 at home to Raith.
Celtic's match at Dunfermline was postponed because of a frozen pitch while Rangers play in the Scottish Cup final on Sunday.
